EC1: (1)Women who are pregnant [OR] and/or lactating [OR]; or women who intend to conceive within a year;
EC2: (2)History of allergies to enalapril [OR], folic acid [OR] or other components of the compound drug;
EC3: (3)History of adverse reactions [OR] or intolerance to enalapril [OR] or other ACE inhibitors [OR], or drugs or supplements containing folic acid;
EC5: (5)Known serious medical conditions, including: Cardiovascular: patients with clinically diagnosed cardiac dysfunction [OR] (NYHA class III and above), hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy [OR], clinically significant valvular heart disease [OR], acute coronary syndrome [OR] within the last 3 months, or percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) [OR], or coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) [OR]; or abnormal pre-enrollment ECG test results with clinically significant arrhythmias [OR] (atrial flutter [OR], atrial fibrillation [OR], grade [OR] II-III atrioventricular block, etc.); Digestive: a previous diagnosis of various types of viral hepatitis [OR] that are still in the active phase; abnormal pre-enrollment liver function test [OR] results (ALT [OR], AST [OR], GGT [OR], TBIL [OR], or DBIL 3 times higher than normal, ALB = 30g/L); gastrectomy [OR] and/or gastrojejunostomy [OR]; gastrointestinal dysfunction [OR]; Urinary: pre-enrollment serum creatinine [OR] greater than 200umol/L; clinical diagnosis of renal artery stenosis [OR], isolated kidney [OR], kidney transplantation [OR] and/or other diseases; Endocrine: type 1 diabetes [OR] or uncontrolled type 2 diabetes [OR] (fasting blood glucose above 11.1 mmol/L at pre-enrollment); previous diagnosis of hyperthyroidism [OR] and failure to correct; Respiratory: pulmonary heart disease [OR]; chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [OR]; Neuropsychiatric: recent transient ischemic attack [OR] or stroke [OR] (within the last 3 months); peripheral [OR] or severe autonomic dysfunction [OR]; mental [OR] or nervous system dysfunction [OR], inability to express desire [OR]; known drug [OR] or alcohol dependence [OR]; Malignancy [OR], malnutrition [OR], hematopoietic disorders and other serious diseases.
EC6: (6)Significant signs of abnormalities [AND] as seen in laboratory tests or physical characteristics, which, at the discretion of the investigators, indicates that the patient is experiencing a serious illness or, may affect the observation and evaluation of the drug's efficacy or adverse events, or renders the patient unsuitable for participating in this study;
EC7: (7)Patients currently taking folate [OR], B12 [OR], or B6, or any compounds containing them, who express an inability [OR] or a refusal to stop usage;
EC8: (8)Regular usage [OR] of folic acid supplements [OR] or compounds containing folic acid in the past 3 months;
EC9: (9)Participation in a clinical trial [AND] for a drug that has not yet been officially approved for marketing within one month prior to the first visit.
